name: Demo G14: Move-Like Redline Duct Route
description: Exercise a move-like redline operation using a disposable modeled duct route: create the route, move every created id, prove the model-space delta, and clean it up.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view and ordered model-space points where a short unconnected duct route can be created, moved, and deleted safely.
success_criteria: A disposable duct route is created through /revit/mep-route-workflow with created model ids.
Native move dry-run and apply effect evidence include every created duct/fitting id.
Visible inventory proves the requested model-space movement vector.
A deterministic move visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
The moved duct route is cleaned up with native dry-run and applied delete effect evidence.
failure_criteria: The disposable duct route is not created or returns no model ids.
Move dry-run or apply omits any created duct/fitting id from effect evidence.
The before/after visible-element inventory cannot prove the requested movement vector.
Cleanup delete dry-run/apply omits any created duct/fitting id from effect evidence.
grader_notes: This task covers move-like duct redlines using real model-write evidence.
All created duct/fitting ids must be represented in move and cleanup evidence.
